units.note: SNES 'Huh!? All gone?' has two exact Android-English copies (1626/1689). Android 1626 sits in the Kakkara/Amar block immediately after the Ice Country/warm-town discussion and before King Amar, whereas 1689 belongs to the unrelated game-over block. The French payloads are semantically identical apart from leading layout, so 1626 is the unique scene identity.
